content.short: Lending Pond is Cardano's first Nft collateralized borrowing platform to go live on mainnet.
content.description: Lending Pond allows individuals borrow against their NFTs and unlock liquidity. Lenders may lend to the borrowers for a set yield determined by the borrower and lender. Lending Pond is committed to keeping the CNFT community to have sufficient liquidity and has been trusted to already have done over 400k ADA in two weeks since launch.
